carryover: Iteration 35 made debug feedback and audit correlation reliable. The next real-use blocker is the explicit-navigation false negative: Chrome tab navigation can complete and reach the requested URL, but Browser Bridge currently reports failure when the full changed DOM observation is not captured in time.
confirmedDecisions: Only explicit navigate-to-URL commands should use lightweight tab-state proof as a success finalizer.
History navigation such as back/forward must not be loosened by this sprint because a URL change alone may be the wrong user-visible destination.
The proof must preserve metadata that full DOM observation was unavailable so later diagnostics can distinguish lightweight from DOM-backed verification.
newGoal: Finalize explicit Browser Action navigation success when the active tab reaches the requested URL even if the changed DOM after-observation is unavailable.
